# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not disclose security vulnerabilities in a public issue. Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting for [isac322/cc-lb](https://github.com/isac322/cc-lb/security/advisories/new). If that route is unavailable, use the contact details on the website linked from the [repository owner's public GitHub profile](https://github.com/isac322) before opening any public report.

Include the affected version or commit, deployment mode, reproduction steps, impact, and relevant logs with secrets and tokens removed. A small proof of concept is welcome when it does not expose real credentials or customer data.

## Scope and handling

Reports are welcome for the current `master` branch and tagged releases. The project does not promise a response time, remediation time, or service-level agreement. Maintainers will assess reports as resources allow and will coordinate disclosure when a fix is available.

For operational questions and non-sensitive bugs, use [GitHub issues](https://github.com/isac322/cc-lb/issues) or the [documentation](https://cc-lb.bhyoo.com/docs/).
